title: Deploy and prove W6 P0 closeout on live SIT
objective: After Claude completes W6-CLAUDE-P0-PRODUCT-CLOSEOUT-01, deploy dev through the Openclaw control plane and produce a customer-review proof pack for the W6 P0 path.
preconditions: Do not deploy until the Claude completion report exists and the referenced commit is on dev.
Do not modify the VPS directly.
Use Openclaw workflows for deploy only.
Do not claim UAT proof from SIT-only evidence.

work_items.title: Deploy dev to SIT via Openclaw
work_items.pass_condition: Record workflow URL, deployed SHA, health/ready status, auth smoke, and route status for /phase2/prototype.

work_items.title: Prove Upload -> Processing -> Review Scan
work_items.pass_condition: A small known document set reaches Review Scan with party fields visible and company Tax ID match/warning behavior recorded.

work_items.title: Prove line-item decision flow
work_items.pass_condition: Per-line confirm/reject/unconfirm and Approve All behavior are captured with screenshots and payload/evidence.

work_items.title: Prove Export selected documents
work_items.pass_condition: Select a subset, preview/download, and show that output contains only selected documents. Include Excel/date behavior evidence.

work_items.title: Prove Companies and Template Configurator visible controls
work_items.pass_condition: COA/AP/AR/Product tabs show consistent table controls. Template modes are wired or clearly disabled. Manual fallback is reachable.

proof_requirements: Each browser proof must show the app left login and reached the target screen.
Capture screenshots, network/API evidence where practical, and final status table.
Any fail/partial item must be marked Deferred + customer-safe wording or Hidden.
Write a final report with commit SHA, deploy SHA, proof artifacts, and go/no-go recommendation.
